WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
att AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at>=e.t),
fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t),
sim AS (SELECT market_ticker, pnl, assumed_price, model_probability, edge, resolved_value,
        CASE WHEN market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) THEN 'A_filled'
             WHEN market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) THEN 'B_ordered_nofill'
             ELSE 'C_never_ordered' END bucket
        FROM paper_trades, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND closed_at>=e.t)
SELECT bucket k,
       'n='||lpad(count(*)::text,3)
       ||'  simPnL='||lpad(to_char(sum(pnl),'FM990.00'),6)
       ||'  perTrade='||lpad(to_char(avg(pnl)*100,'FM990.00'),5)||'c'
       ||'  entry='||lpad(to_char(avg(assumed_price),'FM990.0'),5)
       ||'  edge='||lpad(to_char(avg(edge),'FM990.000'),6)
       ||'  modelP='||lpad(to_char(avg(model_probability),'FM990.000'),6)
       ||'  winrate='||lpad(to_char(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN pnl>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),'FM990.0'),5)||'%' v
FROM sim GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'D_fill_by_price_'||width_bucket(limit_price,80,100,5)::text,
       'band='||min(limit_price)::text||'-'||max(limit_price)::text
       ||'  attempted='||lpad(count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker)::text,4)
       ||'  filled='||lpad(count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) THEN o.market_ticker END)::text,4)
       ||'  rate='||lpad(to_char(100.0*count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl) THEN o.market_ticker END)/NULLIF(count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker),0),'FM990.0'),5)||'%'
FROM live_orders o, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'E_status_'||COALESCE(o.status,'?'), 'orders='||count(*)::text||'  distinct_tickers='||count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker)::text||'  reasons='||COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(o.cancel_reason,'-'),','),'-')
FROM live_orders o, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
